card.name: Noun after 'susceptible' or similar adjective
card.fires_on: The noun right after a word like susceptible, suitable or nontolerant, mainly 'individuals' or 'patients' in warnings about who is at risk. It also fires on a few other spots in drug-label headings.

modes.description: The group noun ('individuals', 'patients', 'conditions') right after an adjective describing susceptibility or suitability.
